findings.claim: The L16 log entry still says a page carrying engram_revision but no engram_id no longer yields a revision. This fix round reverses that: revisionOf reads the revision without an id, and the new test pins it. The Log now contradicts the code. The 22-step differential is also stated for the earlier commit, not for this fix.

The Engram-bridged match now has RawRevision and RevisionKey blanked, whereas it previously carried the memorycard revision. If any consumer of engramPages calls resolve() or reads RawRevision, it now sees revision 0 where it saw the memorycard revision before. The diff does not show the consumers, so no regression is proven; the change deserves a check or a pinned test for engramPages consumers.

evidence: Reviewed the diff only. Traced fieldOf, revisionOf and identityOf on legacy, store-agnostic and mixed-store pages; per-field fallback stays within the same store.
The unparseable-revision errors now name RevisionKey as intended; for the empty-value case the key falls back to the legacy key, which is harmless since an empty revision is never parsed.
The Reconcile error message text changed; any test asserting the old wording would break, but none is visible in the diff.
